description: New key rt.custom-builds.v1 (array of build objects). New key rt.custom-chars.v1 (names of wholly new non-canonical characters). IIFE before UI init reads both keys and merges into DATA in-place: MC builds pushed to DATA.mc_builds; companion variants appended to DATA.companions[char]; new chars create DATA.companions[char] fresh. Merge archetypes and extras maps too. Zero changes to render code — custom builds flow through existing card/timeline/gear paths.
title: Custom build storage + runtime DATA merge
